findings.issue: The 'Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz 2026' live-now row wraps its title one word per line ('Saint' / 'Louis' / 'Rapid &' / 'Blitz 2026', 4 lines) instead of filling the row width, because the long channel label 'YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club) +1' is `white-space: nowrap` and claims its full natural width via `margin-left: auto` (docs/css/cards.css `.live-item .live-meta`), squeezing the title span (`.live-name`, no min-width/flex-basis) into a narrow leftover column. Same row wraps 3 lines at 393px ('Saint Louis' / 'Rapid & Blitz' / '2026'); at 900px the row fits on one line since there's enough width for both. The neighboring 'National Bank Open presented by Rogers' row (longer title, but channel is just '–') stays unwrapped, confirming the channel-label width is what's squeezing the title. Not a truncation/hidden-info bug — every word is still legible — but it makes the DIREKTE NÅ section look cramped and broken on the two mobile widths that matter most.

notes: Every visible row shows a Norwegian-relevant channel — TV 2 Play (Eliteserien/OBOS-ligaen/Champions League/Conference League matches), HBO Max (Sport) (Tour de Pologne, Wyndham Championship), NRK (EM friidrett 2026), VG+ Sport / Viaplay (Brann–Apollon Limassol on different days), YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club) — or an honest faint '–' for the still-undated National Bank Open. No foreign broadcaster (FOX/ESPN/Sky) spotted at any width.

Match names read in full at every width, wrapping across multiple lines rather than clipping: Vålerenga–Bodø/Glimt, Viking–Sarpsborg 08, Stabæk–Lyn, Start–Fredrikstad, Lillestrøm–Rosenborg, HamKam–Aalesund, Kristiansund–Molde, Sandefjord–KFUM Oslo, Brann–Apollon Limassol, Bodø/Glimt–Union Saint-Gilloise, Apollon Limassol–Brann — no side of a fixture hidden.

National flags and club crests render as solid graphics (no broken-image icons or empty boxes) on Tour de Pologne, Tour de France Femmes, EM friidrett, and every Eliteserien/cup fixture at all three widths.

Multi-day events (National Bank Open, Tour de Pologne, Tour de France Femmes, Wyndham Championship, EM friidrett) show date ranges plus 'neste: Etappe 5 · 5 etapper · TV 2 Play'-style framing rather than one misleading time.

No horizontal scroll or edge clipping at 375/393; single quiet column holds at both mobile widths and centers with even margins at 900px. Must-see accent dots appear on a handful of rows only (Vålerenga–Bodø/Glimt, Lillestrøm–Rosenborg, Kristiansund–Molde, EM friidrett, Bodø/Glimt–Union Saint-Gilloise), not everywhere.

Assistant FAB (bottom-trailing 'Assistent' sparkles button) rests over the 'Brann–Apollon Limassol' row at 375/393px — per DESIGN.md § Hjelperen (WP-146 variant D) this mid-agenda overlap is sanctioned, not a bug. It never occludes the last agenda row ('Apollon Limassol – Brann' at 375/393, or the last visible row at 900) or the footer at any width. At 900px it sits labelled in the empty margin beside the 640px column, overlapping nothing.

Header (wordmark, date, theme toggle), Morgenbriefen headline, 'Uka'/'Nyheter' tabs, 'DIREKTE NÅ' section, 'Neste opp' chess list, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer (usage-budget line, calendar subscribe, Aktivitet/Personvern) all intact and aligned at every width checked.

Could not assess: real browser tap-target/interaction behavior (only static full-page screenshots were reviewed); could not pixel-zoom into individual crest icons to rule out subtle rendering artifacts.
